stat_guide_body: HP (+5 per point) Max health. Shield: your HP points build a shield at the start of every battle, absorbed before HP (up to 50% of max HP, reduced by armor pierce). Layers: more HP points add extra shield layers, blue, then dark blue, orange, violet, red. Each layer is a full pool and breaks one after another. No limit past the World Gate. Lifesteal and Absorb fill HP first, then top up the layer you are on. ATK (+1 per point) Attack damage per hit. Combo: ATK points give extra-hit chance (up to 3 extra hits). Combo tiers multiply every extra hit, like a critical. DEF (+1 per point) Directly reduces incoming damage (at least 15% gets through). Block: DEF points give a chance to halve a hit (max 20%). Reflect: part of the blocked damage is dealt back, multiplied per reflect tier. Guard: putting most of your points into DEF unlocks Guard tiers past the World Gate. Each tier cuts every hit you take by 10%, compounding, no limit. AGI (+1 per point) Crit: AGI×0.15% Crit Dmg: 1.5× + AGI×0.075% (max 4×) Dodge: AGI×0.035% (max 20%) Crit chance above 100% becomes crit tiers, each tier multiplies again (max 5). LUC (+1 per point) Gold: LUC×0.1% Drop Rate: → +0.5% (10K LUC) → +0.75% (1B LUC) How it adds up Shield, Combo, Block, Reflect and Guard scale with the points you allocate, not with gear, and are reduced by monster resistance. Concentrating your points in one stat earns extra tiers for that stat; spreading them evenly earns none. Every all-in build is measured to land within 25% of a balanced one. Tap the chart button in battle to see your real numbers against the current enemy.

notice_launch_body:
Thank you for playing Infinite Loot-Loop.

In this release:
• The full route — Grassland, Forest, Volcano, Desert and the Underwater depths
• 25 bosses to hunt down
• Characters to collect, each with their own bonuses
• An item collection that grants permanent stats as it fills
• Achievements, leaderboards and cloud save

More is on the way. See you in the loop.
notice_hardmode_body:
Hard Mode is open.

Every region returns with tougher monsters, and the whole route can be run again at a higher tier.

• 20 Hard bosses, each with its own reward
• A full tier of Hard equipment
• Clear all 20 to unlock the Oracle

Hard Mode unlocks after you clear the normal route. Deaths cost more here — bring gear.
notice_worldgate_body:
The World Gate is open.

Four regions lie beyond it — Japan, Greece, the Military Zone and Heaven — each with its own monsters, gear and boss.

• 5 new bosses, ending with Archangel Sovereign
• A new tier of equipment in every region
• Heaven climbs through nine zones, each tougher than the last

The Gate opens once you have cleared all 20 route bosses in Hard Mode. Good luck.
notice_pencil_301_body:
BALANCE
The Maze has been re-paced. Enemy levels now rise properly across all 27 maps, so each map is a real step forward instead of one you pass straight through.

Maze bosses are now clearly stronger than the monsters around them. Two of them were barely tougher than ordinary enemies.

REWARDS WHEN NO AD IS AVAILABLE
If you choose to watch an ad for a revive or bonus gold and none can be shown, you now receive the reward anyway. Previously you got nothing.

APPLE PENCIL ON iPad
Apple Pencil and trackpad input now move your character. Previously only a finger worked. Thank you to the player who reported it.

Nothing you have bought or earned is affected. Thank you for playing.
notice_maze_300_body:
The Maze is open.

Four regions lie beyond the World Gate hub — the Maze, the Ice fields, America and the Amazon. 27 maps in Normal Mode.

• 6 new bosses, ending with The Verdant Mother
• 124 new monsters and a full tier of gear in every region
• Defeat Fracture Warden to open Ice, The Hollow Twin to open America, and Glassmaw to open the Amazon

Hard Mode for these four regions will follow in a later update.

LEVELLING HAS CHANGED
Your level bonus now follows the stats you invest in. Put every point into one stat and it takes the whole bonus; a stat you never raise gets none. Each stat row now shows its exact percentage.

LEADERBOARD
• Every board can be filtered by All, iOS or Android
• Outside the top 50 your real rank now shows instead of 0
• Hard Mode runs now score on the Stage board

Thank you for playing.
notice_balance_204_body:
Thank you for playing — and for the reports that made this update.

• Leaderboard scores display correctly again. Very large scores were being shown as unreadable text.
• World Gate Hard Mode has been re-checked from end to end and rebalanced. Critical hits and dodge now tighten as you go deeper, so Greece, the Military Zone and Heaven are the step up they were always meant to be.

COMING NEXT — THE MAZE
A new Normal Mode chapter is planned for early to mid September. It opens in the Maze and continues through three more regions: Ice, America and the Amazon.

Thank you for playing.

notice_draw_302_title: v3.0.2 — Gold Draw & Quality of Life
notice_draw_302_body:
NEW: GOLD DRAW
When your run ends, your leftover gold no longer just disappears. On the Run Over screen, stake it on the Gold Draw for a chance at items from monsters and bosses you have already defeated. Any amount works — even 1 G — and your exact chance is always shown. Bigger stakes, better odds; boss items are the rare jackpot.

NEW: DROP LIST IN BATTLE
Tap the ? beside a monster to see what it can drop, your exact chance for each item, and how many copies you have collected. Undiscovered items appear only as silhouettes. When everything is at MAX, that monster has nothing left to give.

NEW: INSTANT BATTLE
Once Hard Mode is unlocked, a new button under the encounter gauge starts a fight on the spot — no more walking to fill the gauge.

Thank you for playing.

notice_stats_303_body:
CHARACTER STATS NOW MATTER
A character's stat multipliers (for example x1.5 ATK) used to boost only the small base stat, which gear quickly buried. They now also scale the points you allocate for the level bonus and for the new stat effects below, so a high-ATK character really does hit harder at every stage. The flat number on the stat page is still mostly gear; look at the "Lv +%" line and the Combo / Shield / Block readouts to see the difference.

EVERY STAT HAS A SECOND JOB
• HP — Shield: every battle starts with a blue shield on your HP bar that absorbs damage before your health.
• ATK — Combo: extra hits now come from ATK, not AGI.
• DEF — Block and Reflect: a chance to halve a hit (max 20%), and a blocked hit throws part of the damage back at the enemy.
• AGI — Crit chance, Crit damage and Dodge.
• LUC — Gold and Drop chance only.
These effects grow with the points you allocate, not with gear. The Stat Guide (?) on the allocation screen lists every formula and cap.

NEW
• Battle Stats: a chart button under the "?" in battle shows your crit, crit damage, combo, dodge, block, shield, reflect and damage cut against the enemy in front of you.
• The stat page now lists all nine derived stats, crit damage included.
• Gold Draw has a proper reveal. Tap to skip.

BALANCE
• Enemies and bosses past the World Gate resist crit, combo and dodge 1.5x more.
• Templar reworked into a true tank: HP 1.4 / ATK 1.1 / DEF 1.4 / AGI 0.9 / LUC 1.0.

FIXES
• Maze, Ice, America and Amazon: monsters now drop only their own zone's item. A bug let every monster in a region drop the whole region shop, including later maps' gear.
• Greece – Harbor of Columns: the arch at the top is the exit again.
• Military – Supply Depot and Bunker Network: every painted road and corridor is now walkable.
• Ice – Frozen Throne: the portal back to the Maze fork no longer sits on the ring path.
• Store tabs are sorted cheapest first.
• Troll collectibles show their icon on every screen, and the ones dropped by bosses show the boss icon too.
• World Gate Japan: the first monster is a little easier for players arriving from Underwater hard.
• Gold Draw could be pulled twice on one result screen; fixed.
• Continuing a run after a death no longer refills Adventure Points.
• Confirming a large manual stat allocation no longer freezes the game.

Thank you for playing.
notice_wg_304_body:
WORLD GATE PACING
• Zones now get harder as you go: inside each map every zone hits at least as hard as the one before, and the next map opens close to where the last one ended. The dip at each map's first zone is gone, so pushing through a map is the way to its gear.
• Boss maps are the exception on purpose: their fields stay softer and the boss is the wall.
• The route is a little tougher overall from Greece on. The first fight in each new map now expects the gear from the map before.

GEAR
• Some drops in Japan and Greece were weaker than gear from earlier zones of the same map (the Sakura set in JP02, the Shogun set in JP03, several Olympian and Zeus pieces). They have been raised so every later zone is a real upgrade. Nothing was lowered.
• Drop Bonus from LUC no longer stops at +0.6%. It keeps climbing deep into the endgame, up to +0.75%. Loot Boost and Lucky Hunter are added on top, exactly as before.

FIXES
• World Gate hard: Japan and Greece monsters now rise one by one across map seams with no soft first zones, and crit / dodge resistance is re-anchored to the gear a player actually carries mid-run. The arrival fight in each map is unchanged.
• Gold Draw stakes all of your gold on the pull — a bigger stake means better odds, and that gold vanishes at the next run anyway. One draw per run over, and the button now says so.
• The +20% gold ad on the result screen locks after a Gold Draw, since that gold could never be spent. Watch the ad first and the draw stakes the bigger pot.
• The FIGHT button moved next to the encounter gauge, out of the lane you walk through.
• Buttons you cannot use right now are greyed out instead of looking active.
• Stage leaderboard: every map now has its own step, so a clear anywhere always moves you forward. Existing records are being re-scored to the new steps.
• Shield shows as a blue bar over the HP bar that empties as it absorbs hits.
• Money box: gold on top, diamonds below.

Thank you for playing.
notice_400_body:
THE ROAD TO MONOCHROME
• The route past the Amazon now runs nine legs: the Graveyard, the Maze in Hard Mode, Korea, the Ice Lands in Hard Mode, London, America in Hard Mode, the Amazon in Hard Mode, and finally Monochrome — twenty maps and three bosses at the end of everything.
• Four new regions: the Graveyard (10 maps), Korea (8), London (8) and Monochrome (20). Hard Mode mirrors of the Maze, Ice, America and the Amazon, each with its own monsters and gear.
• Difficulty is the only gate. Every door opens when you can survive what is behind it.
• A region's shop and item list appear after your first kill in that region. The last map of each region opens a portal back once its boss falls.

EVERY STAT MATTERS
• ATK: combo chains now grow a COMBO MULTIPLIER — past the first tier, every extra hit multiplies like a critical.
• HP: your shield now comes in LAYERS — blue, then dark blue, then orange — each a full pool. Break one, the next takes over.
• DEF: blocks now REFLECT harder, tier by tier.
• Going all-in on one stat is now a real build: every build is measured to land within 25% of a balanced one.
• HP and DEF keep paying past the World Gate: shield layers and reflect tiers have no ceiling any more, and a DEF-focused build now cuts every hit it takes, tier by tier.

GOLD DRAW
• Every coin you stake now raises the chance — farmed, exchanged from diamonds, or earned from ads — all the way toward 100%.
• Overflow pays more: stake 100× the ask and a SECOND item can drop, 10,000× and a third. Every tier's chance is on the panel.

VOID HUNT
• The Void no longer sends foes whose every drop you already hold at the copy cap. Finish a monster's loot and it steps aside for the ones you still need.

GEAR
• Main route: 118 items lifted so later zones and higher rarities always ascend, map by map. Nothing was lowered.

WORLD GATE HARD
• Re-paced for the stronger builds above: the revive is needed again.

SECRETS
• Five secrets are hidden in the game. None of them is a mechanic. Tap around.

FIXES
• Statistics page showed nothing on some devices.
• Shield bar redrawn: full height, fills left to right.
• Guaranteed drops no longer favour the first item on the list: they now roll by the same odds as every other drop.
• Winning your last AP battle now shows the results and your loot before the run ends.

notice_402_body:
WORLD GATE — EASIER, BOTH MODES
• Monster resistances lowered across Japan, Greece and the Military Yard.
• All five World Gate bosses eased. Nothing was made harder.

YOUR WIN STREAK IS NOW VISIBLE
• Winning in a row multiplies your gold and EXP up to x2. It was never shown — now it appears on the map, in battle, and on the victory screen.
• Losing resets it, which is why rewards drop afterwards. Ten wins bring it back.

AP ACCESSORIES FIXED
• "Equip Best" was quietly removing Chaos Heart. It no longer does.
• Gear AP now applies while the accessory is worn.

RELIC BALANCE
• Boss relic effects stacked with no ceiling. Heartwood's lifesteal and Nine-Dragon's shield layers are reduced, and First Dead's dodge now sits inside the 20% cap.

FIXES
• The Void map no longer sends monsters whose drops you've already completed.
• The +20% gold reward was paying less than 20%. Salvage and diamond-exchanged gold now count.
• "CRITICAL!" and "COMBO!" appeared in English in every language.
• Ads return to the preferred network after a temporary outage.
